packageRules.description: Tag-tracking actions (non-semver refs) only get digest updates, which have no release timestamp, so the age gate would block them forever
Patch updates are low-review-effort; land them as one PR

optative-script pins an rquickjs major, and tauler uses rquickjs types directly at the UI-component registration boundary (src/ui/registry.rs, src/jsx.rs). Two rquickjs versions in the graph make `Ctx`/`Error` fail to unify, so a lone bump of any one of these never compiles. Pinned, not bumped: a caret range lets `cargo update` resolve past the version Renovate picked, which is how the two copies get in.

takumi re-exports takumi-core types; a lone bump of either puts two takumi-core versions in the graph and the ImageSource/ImageBuffer types stop unifying. Pinned for the same reason as the quickjs group — under `bump`, `minimumReleaseAge` held takumi at 2.7.3 while the lockfile update resolved 2.9.2, and the two takumi-core versions that pulled in did not compile.
Starlight and its themes/integrations peer-depend on the Astro major.
Action digest bumps are independent and noisy; one PR is enough.

docs-ci.yaml pins its job container to the same mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image tag docs/scripts/update-snapshots.sh derives from @playwright/test — two copies of one version (ADR 0031). Overrides the generic github-actions grouping above so this doesn't drift out of sync inside a batch of unrelated action bumps.
